svg.title: CHISUM: Stern ramp: arrangement and motion, JS3-304 revision 1
svg.text: Stern ramp: arrangement and motion, sheet 1 of 4 · JS3-304 · revision 1 · 12 November 2026
Johansson Shipyard, newbuilding No. 1, the 124.8 m ro-ro freight ferry. Drawn before the steel, from the numbers her model is built from. Revision 0 drew the 68.4 m ship and is superseded.
Metres. Heights over the main deck; the design waterline is 1.0 m under it.
A PROFILE ON THE PORT CYLINDER, 4.25 m off the centreline, looking to port
lowest (94°): the flaps' ends +0.04 m from the water
B THE DOOR FROM INSIDE, looking aft (port is to the right): the ramp raised and locked
clear driveway 8 m, between the cylinders
A B C D cross to starboard over the door's head
C PLAN AT THE MAIN DECK (bow to the right, port up): the ramp level, the flaps down
THE MOTION, by the control (0: raised and locked)
the flaps start to fold out
The cylinders pull: the oil that carries the ramp is on their rod sides (480 cm² each), where the load-holding valves
are. Weight taken as 55 t at half the leaf's length; no wind, no vehicle on it, no friction. Stroke 3.40 m, of which
3.25 m is used. To raise it from its lowest takes 312 litres: 94 s with both pumps, 187 s with one. On the page it is
worked at 1.5 of the control a second.
A box girder 11 x 9.4 m, 0.42 m deep, tapered over its last 1.6 m; non-slip bars on the roadway
inside the opening; flat where it meets the seal. RMP-01
Six: a lug of the ship in a slot of the leaf's foot at 0.75, 2.35, 3.95 m each side; one pin of
Two, bore 300, rod 170, stroke 3.40 m, each with a load-holding valve and two hoses. RMP-03,
Two cheeks under the web beam at 3.6 m, tied to the mooring station's wall.
2.2 m from the hinge; they stand in through the opening when the ramp is raised.
8 of 1.1 x 1.2 m, folded back over the roadway when stowed. RMP-05
Eight, four a side at 0.7, 1.5, 3.3, 4.4 m: a 70 mm bolt through the door post into a keeper on
Two at the door's head, 2.2 m each side. RMP-19, RMP-20
Rubber, on the transom round the opening's sides and head. RMP-06
A desk against the wall beside the door, port: emergency stop, start and stop for each pump, the
CLEATS and RAMP levers; two pressure indicators, eight lamp windows, key switch, instructions; a
beacon. Its faces are drawn on sheet 3. RMP-30
Tank of 1,500 l, two pumps of 37 kW, the cleats' pump, cooler, filters, hand pump. HYD-01 to
Three lever valves with solenoids, on the hydraulic room's inboard wall. HYD-10
On the hydraulic room's forward wall. ELD-51 (sheet 3)
A, B (cylinders, 30 mm), C, D (cleats, 18 mm) and the control stand's conduit E: level runs in
one layer, upright runs in a second.
The fourteen position switches, behind the control stand. RMP-31
One on each door post at 1.1 m: an arm whose tooth falls by its own weight behind a striker on
the leaf; no oil holds it. Lifted 30° by a small cylinder, or by its handle; a pin for the sea.
The leaf's own scantlings, its pins and the seating of the brackets on the web beam are not calculated: 55 t is the design
The quays she lies at, their heights and the tide are not known. 4° under the level is all her freeboard at the stern
Clear driveway 8 m in an opening of 9 m: the cylinders stand inside the opening. Two trailers abreast pass; three do not.
The lights of the after end (the sternlight NLT-06, two floodlights, the red and green signal) are as revision 0 placed
them (spec.STERN_LIGHTS); the floodlights and the signal have no circuit yet.
The ramp cover over the fixed ramp, which the same power pack is to work, is not built.
All three views at this scale.

Made by ferry/yard/drawings/stern_drawing.py from ferry/blender/stern_place.py, spec.py, lines.py, ga.py and ferry/systems/stern.py (arrangement revision D): the numbers the model and the register are built from.
